name: entity_forum_search
description: Topics matching the forum search box: words in the title, opening post or published replies, optionally within one forum and its sub-forums.

options.text_input_required: Enter one or more words to search the forum topics and replies.

display_options.display_comment: The forum search page. The search box on the forums index and forum pages (entity_forum_search_box_form) submits here, passing ?search= and, from a forum page, ?forum=. Private forums and held topics are removed by entity_forum_views_query_alter(), as on every topic view.
